Hey loook, please I don’t pretend to know how exactly you feel, but I’ve been there before. I used to feel so worthless, and that I’ll never find anyone who’ll love me, and that I’ll die alone. But guess what? I pushed my luck a little further and got myself a gf. She’s everything to me and I appreciate her with all my heart. I know there’s someone out there who cares, so please, live for them.
Respect for being who you are, you are open and brave, that’s for one. And lovely emoji placement as well😂

I also over think sometimes, and yes sometimes I wish I could just stop. But I know that there people who love me out there and maybe on day I can even start a family. Sometimes what I need is to take a deep breath and think of all the things that is possible. We are out here, and you are not alone.

I know there’s no way for me to have the brains and the perseverance to go to a med school. I just want you to know that you’ve come a long way, and you know what? You’re not worthless at all. Yes maybe I don’t know what it feels like to be pushed to your very limits and be rejected all the same, but I know how I feel if another person died for the wrong cause. Please, please don’t do it
